name: [[294,42,11]] weight-6 pair-partition CPM code on a sparse 6x14 template, P = 21
solver: exhaustive search, two independent implementations (exactA, exactB; sources github.com/TimoKellerMath/quantum-error-correction @ aaa18674c9a1, two-block-and-amplified-codes/src, sha256 2d1f0d1a55d9..., e793e5b34eb6...; records github.com/TimoKellerMath/quantum-error-correction @ 2a15e549f6f4, pair-partition-and-two-block-codes/294-42-11/records)
encoding: cluster growth through unsatisfied checks of the constraining matrix (H_X for Z-logicals, H_Z for X-logicals), with exclusions and unit propagation, and a majority rule over the rows of the other matrix and the sums of two of them that share a qubit; anchors: pattern classes of the 6 check orbits under the translations of Z_21 (exactA, 186 jobs), one anchor per qubit orbit with the earlier orbits excluded (exactB, 14 runs); search through W = d - 1 = 10, no parity reduction

X.note: no nontrivial X-logical of weight <= 10 (W = 10): exactA 4284 nodes, 0.01 s; exactB 4721 nodes, 0.00 s (on a laptop; a rerun on byte-identical copies reproduced the node counts); dist-m4ri 0.16.1 and tropidist b03ec2d4077f, run without symmetry, also give d_X = 11

Z.note: no nontrivial Z-logical of weight <= 10 (W = 10): exactA 4069 nodes, 0.01 s; exactB 4873 nodes, 0.01 s (on a laptop; a rerun on byte-identical copies reproduced the node counts); dist-m4ri 0.16.1 and tropidist b03ec2d4077f, run without symmetry, also give d_Z = 11

verification.note: exactA and exactB (independently written exhaustive searches) find no nontrivial logical of weight <= 10 on either side, so d = 11 with the witnesses of the entry (Theorem 5 of pair-partition-and-two-block-codes/README.md).
